import html # Base HTML template with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ Visitor Page

Welcome!

{user_content}
""" def create_html_response(visitor_content: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML response embedding the user-provided content in a safe manner. Parameters ---------- visitor_content : str The raw string supplied by the user that should appear inside the page. Returns ------- str The full HTML document with the user content safely escaped. """ # Escape special characters to prevent HTML injection (CWE-74). safe_content = html.escape(visitor_content, quote=True) # Render the template with the escaped content. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
